_note: Docs of record: 01-game/tasks.md (structure) and 02-economy/currency-model.md (amounts, targets). This file is the shipping copy the game loads (doc-conventions rule 6). Pool entries carry available_from (UTC date): the daily draw filters on it, so a mid-day deploy cannot reshuffle a day in progress. Operational rule: pool additions ship available_from >= deploy day + 2 (decisions/0024). 1.1.0: the tour gains its equip step and feature_firsts arrives (additive, decisions/0025).
